summary.text: Modern Horizons 2 gathers stories from Dominaria, where Serra speaks a single word, "Hope," into the smothering dark and Riptide Laboratory researchers, working with the best of intentions, unwittingly unleash a plague of troubles.

Dakkon, a master smith subjugated by demonic forces, forges the Blackblade for Geyadrone Dihada and unwittingly becomes part of her schemes, while Nevinyrral destroys all of his magic along with himself as a final act of spite.
